insights.heading: ST5 revenue rose by 2.6M (429.6%), from 607.0K to 3.2M compared with the same period last year.
insights.content: It made up 74.2% of the overall increase. Units sold rose by 1.7M (418.0%), from 407.9K to 2.1M. This added 2.5M to revenue. Revenue per item rose 2.2%, from 1.49 to 1.52. This added 70.1K to the gain. Check ST5 by product and branch to find where the change happened.
